title: Fleshy
summary: FLESH'Y, adjective 1. Full of flesh; plump; musculous. The sole of his foot is fleshy 2. Fat; gross; corpulent; as a fleshy man. 3. Corporeal. 4. Full of pulp; pulpous; plump; as fruit.
